thread:
Elena: Dropping a "rapid review" cheat sheet for Q-cycle and sprint self-reviews. Focus: 4-lines max, plus optional competency tag and promo-evidence line. Copy-paste friendly.

Tom: Love short. Paste the exact template?

Elena: Yep 

IC template:
``` 
Goal: <one-line> 
Outcome: <metric or user impact> 
Evidence: - <one short bullet, link ok> 
Ask (opt): <1-line help> 
Competency (opt): <e.g., ownership, craft> 
PromoEvidence (opt): <one-sentence + artifact link> 
```

Manager template:
``` 
Observed: <one-line observation> 
Impact: <metric or customer outcome> 
Suggested next step: <one-line support> 
Calibration tag: <low/med/high evidence> 
```

Priya: Can we add a peer feedback micro-sentence?

Elena: Yup — paste this for peers: "Observed impact: <short>. Example: <specific>. One suggestion: <concrete next step>." 

ManagerA: Also add a quick rubric note for promo evidence: 1) outcome 2) scope 3) repeatability — one line.

Elena: Done. Final line for promo: "Promo rubric: Outcome: <x>. Scope: <team/org>. Repeatable? <yes/no>. Link: <artifact>"

peopleops-bot: Uploaded: /drive/people-ops/rapid-review-kit-v1.pdf (org) :white_check_mark:

Tom: Nice. I'll push this in the self-review template and include in 1:1 agenda. :thumbsup:

Elena: Thanks — if anyone wants CSV of templates for bulk import to forms, say so and I’ll export.
